pretraining_corpora: MIMIC-IV-ECG v1.0 and PhysioNet/CinC 2021 v1.0.3, the latter containing PTB-XL (github.com/bowang-lab/ECG-FM README, 'Pretrained on')
preprocessing: none beyond the common ingestion: (12, 5000) float32 millivolts at 500 Hz goes into the network unchanged; the checkpoint carries its own normalisation inside fairseq_signals' extract_features, which is applied there and not here
notes: fairseq_signals wav2vec2_cmsc; input (B, 12, 5000) at 500 Hz; mean-pooled extract_features output
ingestion_deviations: lead order and sampling rate are not in the record (no HDF5 attributes); taken from Liu et al. 2022, Data Records
51 of 170 records longer than ten seconds, cropped to the first
